remarks: Incredible value packed 2 bed condo that is walk to everything downtown Stamford has to offer! Perfectly positioned for convenience, this home offers easy access to shops, restaurants, nightlife, and major commuting routes and train station. Step inside to a bright and inviting main level featuring hardwood floors, oversized windows for great natural light, and soaring 9ft ceilings. Spacious living are flows into fully applianced kitchen w/ dishwasher, microwave, and ample cabinet space-ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The main level bedroom is generously sized w/ two double closets. Downstairs a second bedroom offers privacy and flexibility-perfect for guests, a home office, or roommate set up-with direct access to your assigned covered garage parking space just steps away. Enjoy the rare convenience of both exterior private entry and interior access from the garage. Additional highlights include central AC and efficient gas heat for year-round comfort. With covered parking, a commute-friendly location, and unbeatable walkability, this home checks all the boxes for comfort and value.
